tokens.v: A customer's report of a problem is registered, worked within its response time, and either solved on the spot or passed on to a service order or a maintenance sales order.

achieves.text: A customer's report of a problem is registered, worked within its response time, and either solved on the spot or passed on to a service order or a maintenance sales order.

tokens.v: A call records who reported what, on which serialized item. Its response time gives it a priority and the latest times to start and finish solving it, and a timer measures the work. A call is solved by the helpdesk, assigned to a support engineer, or transferred: to a service order for work at the site, or to a maintenance sales order for a repair in the shop. Its Obligations tab shows any contract or warranty covering the item.
